name: application-bulk-action-bar
title: Bulk Action Bar
description: Contextual toolbar that appears once one or more rows are selected in a table or list, showing a selection count and a row of batch actions.
useWhen: Offering batch operations (archive, export, delete) on multiple selected rows in a table or list.
Replacing per-row action menus with a single bar once more than one row is selected.
Pairing with a data table's checkbox column to confirm how many rows are currently selected.
avoidWhen: Only a single row can ever be selected at a time — use per-row actions instead.
There is only one possible bulk action — a single confirm button next to the count is simpler than a toolbar.
The destructive action has no separate confirmation step — pair Delete with a confirmation dialog before it runs.
responsiveBehavior: The floating variant sizes to its content and is meant to be positioned (e.g. fixed to the bottom of the viewport) by the consuming layout; the inline variant is full width and wraps its action group on narrow screens.
accessibility: The bar carries role='toolbar' with an aria-label describing its purpose.
The clear/dismiss control has a real aria-label since it is icon-only.
The destructive action is distinguished by both color and a distinct label, not color alone.

variants.title: Floating pill
variants.description: Floating pill-shaped bar with a selection count, a row of actions, and a dismiss control, meant to float above the page once rows are selected.
accessibility: The dismiss control has an aria-label since it has no visible text.

variants.title: Floating pill (Dark)
variants.description: Floating pill-shaped bulk action bar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Action text and the pill's border must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Inline table toolbar
variants.description: Full-width bar meant to replace a table's header row, with a tinted selected state, a clear checkbox, and a destructive action styled distinctly from secondary actions.
accessibility: The destructive action uses both red color and the word Delete, not color alone, to signal its effect.

variants.title: Inline table toolbar (Dark)
variants.description: Inline table bulk action bar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected-state tint and action text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
